summary: Iteration 191 backend-only testing of Broker Router Audit Log. All acceptance criteria pass. 10 live-API integration tests (via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) plus the 3 requested pytest suites (27 unit tests) all green. PATCH /api/bots/{bot_id}/broker correctly (a) records audit row with bot_id/broker/from_broker in the response, (b) is a no-op when the broker is unchanged, (c) rejects invalid broker values with 400 and no audit write, (d) returns 404 for other-user bots. GET /api/admin/alpha-daytrader/broker-audit returns {switches:[...]} newest-first, respects bot_id and limit filters, and requires auth (401 without bearer). Regression: iteration_190 broker-comparison endpoints still 200.
critical_code_review_comments: record_switch() correctly swallows all Mongo exceptions — good, matches the 'best-effort audit' contract.
PATCH /api/bots/{bot_id}/broker looks up prior_broker BEFORE the update and only writes the audit row when values differ — correct idempotency.

ensure_indexes() is defined but I did not verify it is called from server startup; if not wired, first read/write still works (lazy), but you lose the (bot_id, created_at) index performance. Confirm boot wiring.

operator field falls back to user['_id'] which for owner is an ObjectId — currently coerced via str(...) inside record_switch so it works, but consider always logging email when available for readability.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one TEST_iter191_audit_bot signal bot per module (auto-cleaned via fixture teardown). Left ~2-3 rows in broker_router_audit collection for the created bot's lifecycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 acceptance items pass end-to-end. Integration test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter191_broker_audit_integration.py can be re-run as regression. Unit suite is /app/backend/tests/test_broker_router_audit.py.
